rounds.mechanism: Bell eats a decrementing binary counter on a spacing-3 lattice. Outer cycle starts s = (n, w, v) = R(-1, n, Z). Invariant I = {w >= 3, d = n - 2^(cap+1) >= 2, M != 0} minus (6,4,0), M = n + 2v - 2^(cap+2) mod 3 (n + v - ... when w = 1 mod 3). Lemma M (sign law) keeps M = 0 / != 0. Lemma K: from K a cycle halts only at T_c or (6,4,0) and otherwise lands in K. This stage closes Lemma K for continuation cycles and the nested levels. Shift law: a level started at R(p0, q, Z) is the cycle from (q, Z) moved by p0 + 1, so G(t) = F(t) + 1 is an inner level. The nested bite with k low set bits is k - 1 G-steps from (3, Z >> (k+1)), and a cycle whose first continuation is at R(p_c, 2, Z_c) has F(s) = (p_c + 2) + G^k(3, Z_c[3k+3:]).
closed_gaps: Gap (b), no halt inside nested levels: phase lemma (H only from O2 at q = 4, which needs a phase start in H* = {w = 2, n = 2v + 4} u {w = 1, v = 0, n = 2^(L+1) + 4}), pop parity (n' = p + 1 mod 2 when w' = 1, 2; B0 f = 2 never occurs inside a cycle), Lemma J (J = {w >= 3, n >= 3, n odd if w = 1, 2} is closed under G, no halt, no rule gap). Every phase start except the outer cycle start is in J, so a cycle halts iff its start is in H*; in K that is T_c and (6,4,0).

Gap (a), Lemma K for continuation cycles: A1 p_c >= 2^(L_c) - 3 (chain arithmetic, tight at w = 1 mod 3, d = 2); Lemma Z' (t in J with d <= 1: d(G t) >= 2 or cap(G t) <= cap(t) + 1, by cases with at most one overflow after the first); K-likeness persists in J. Then d(F s) = p_c + 2 + d(t_(k+2)) >= 2 in both cases (K-like inner end: >= 4; zone-dominated: cap <= L_c - 1, n >= 3). Induction on the length of the cycle computation.
(6,4,0) has no predecessor in K: n' >= n - log2(n) roughly (plain) or n' >= 2^(L_c) + 2 (continuation), so a predecessor would sit inside the exhaustive window, which has none.

Checks (scripts/contlemmas.py, closed rules): G-form 20,000/20,000; H* = halting set on 610,121 + 606,121 states; J1/Z'/Kp on 1,920,333 + 479,621 J states; A1/CF/A2 on 533,148 + 151,880 continuation cycles, min d' = 5; 200,000 random large states (w <= 75) 0 failures; TM level G and F agree on random J and K states.
remaining_gaps: proof.md not written yet: the plain-cycle part of Lemma K (stage 2 sketch: f = 1, f = 2 with B1/B2/B0, f >= 3) must be written out in full, with the new Lemmas P, J, A1, Z', the shift law and the composite form

The nested-bite stack (inner walls 1 00, pop = next level's R(0, q', Z')) is justified by TM brute force (252/252) and the G-form check, not yet by a written tape argument; it is the long part of the Rocq build
